verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own event-driven automations: events can trigger device commands such as run_script, events can fire outbound webhooks, and the operations product claims automated incident detection, automated incident response, and fleet orchestration that dispatches help without manual action. However, the docs cover these only in brief one-line mentions. The AI layer explicitly keeps people approving what happens next, so AI-driven work is not autonomous. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring background automation rules, scheduled/recurring jobs, autonomous AI-agent execution without human approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
